results.title: Revocation of Uses of Partially Hydrogenated Oils in Foods; Confirmation of Effective Date

results.title: Requirements for Additional Traceability Records for Certain Foods; Technical Amendment
results.key_finding: This is a purely technical amendment correcting typographical errors and incorrect internal cross-references, with no substantive policy changes that would indicate regulatory capture.

results.title: Proposed Requirements for Tobacco Product Manufacturing Practice; Extension of Comment Period

results.title: Revocation of Uses of Partially Hydrogenated Oils in Foods
results.key_finding: This rule represents genuine consumer protection action, not regulatory capture - FDA is actively revoking industry permissions and removing harmful substances from food supply based on public health determinations made in 2015.

results.key_finding: This rule represents strong consumer protection action - FDA is comprehensively revoking industry's ability to use trans fats across multiple product categories based on clear health harm findings, showing FDA prioritizing public health over industry convenience.

results.title: Use of Salt Substitutes To Reduce the Sodium Content in Standardized Foods
